2. It checks that git, node 18 or later are on your computer, and if marketingskills is missing it runs the get_it steps: git clone https://github.com/coreyhaines31/marketingskills.git ; cd marketingskills.
3. It runs the row's command with your file in place of {input}: node skills/reverse-engineer-marketing/scripts/teardown.mjs example.com
4. Read what it shows you and open the result. Trillion runs none of this; it all happens on your own computer.
